items.title: Dick Griffin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 12, 2024
items.q: He comes up, he used to come up annually and would play with Doctor Woods.

ctx.x: Yes and we’ve had the pleasure of his talents here at Hamilton College a number of times.

Oh yeah. Yeah. He comes up, he used to come up annually and would play with Doctor Woods. But yeah, so now he’s 53 years old, he’s never had a job doing anything but playing music. And he got to be pretty good — well he is pretty good I’ve got to say. He reads very well. He plays all styles, like I do. He just subbed in a Broadway show at the Wintergarden Theater, a really really big show there and he did pretty good there. And he said coming up March 1 he’s going to be doing “Dream Girls,” it’s going to be a…
That is really something in this day and age.
